_provenance: Hand-authored active theory source. The Chapter 6 four-proposition table is projected and checked against these P1–P4 records; native prose remains authoritative. Legacy IDs are archived crosswalk data, not additional active claims.
_intent: Describe a conditional, middle-range theory through four developed propositions, inherited environment dynamics, three outcomes and explicit scope; no calibrated coefficients are claimed.
hedge: N=1: one repository, one fleet, one operator, ~20 weeks focused. These are ANALYTIC-generalization claims (about a mechanism and its scope conditions), not statistical generalization to a population. They are stated so future multi-case / longitudinal / controlled work can test them. Directional and middle-range, not fitted.

spine._note: The shared left-to-right system the four loops run over, read clockwise. Each construct id is reused by the loops, moderators, and hypotheses below.

constructs.name: Agentic capacity
constructs.gloss: Model capability, concurrency, and raw implementation rate. The amplifier: velocity clusters latent weakness in time, so failure classes that would arrive months apart under human-paced work land in a single afternoon, close enough to see the structure they share. Distinguish the INTRINSIC driver — the foundation model's inherent ability, exogenous to the loops — from DEPLOYED agentic capacity (feasible task size, concurrency, ambition), which the environment raises: the purple capability-amplification loop feeds back into deployed capacity — the frontier the operator dares attempt — not the model's intrinsic capability.

constructs.name: Effective governed-environment quality
constructs.gloss: How well the inherited environment supports the work through useful representations, adequate obligation coverage, coherence and economy. Assess these properties independently of resulting performance; apparatus count alone does not measure quality.

dimensions.question: Are the relevant properties legible in the environment's current models?
Are important obligations covered by controls proportionate to their decidability and risk — hard mechanisms where they fit, judgment-based review where they do not?
Do the mechanisms compose without harmful collision or duplication?
Is the governance burden proportionate to the risk and value it controls?

constructs.name: Agentic work
constructs.gloss: Attempted change against the current task frontier. Capacity drives it; the environment shapes it into realized performance.

constructs.name: Realized performance
constructs.gloss: What the work actually delivers: durable throughput, defect escape, and the human attention each unit of durable output costs.

constructs.name: Governance pressure
constructs.gloss: The experienced gap between the performance the fleet looks capable of and the durable performance it delivers: churn, recurring failure, escaped defect, repeated intervention, control friction. The central experienced driver — the pressure an operator actually feels.

constructs.name: Structural diagnosis
constructs.gloss: The scarce act of judgment that reads a signal as a local defect (repair and move on) or as evidence of a missing model, abstraction, boundary, invariant, oracle, mechanism, or governance seam. Pressure is not yet knowledge; diagnosis is.

constructs.name: Governance adaptation
constructs.gloss: The repertoire that changes E: represent (make structure legible), convert (a recurring failure into a durable mechanism), strengthen (weak guidance into harder enforcement), reconcile (duplicated/conflicting controls), retire (stale or net-harmful governance). Subtractive as well as additive.

loops.name: Bootstrap loop
loops.type_note: An input/initialization, NOT a feedback loop — it seeds the initial environment before any agent runs.
loops.reading: Prior engineering knowledge — inherited architecture, tests, controls, standards, prior incidents, lessons transferred from earlier systems — converts into the initial governed environment the initial environment. Governance conversion in one project becomes bootstrap knowledge in the next. Lowers the initial failure rate; does not close the red loop.

loops.name: Churn / discovery loop
loops.type_note: Together with L3 forms a BALANCING loop (see B-loop below): the goal-seeking arm that surfaces pressure.
loops.reading: Work outruns a weak environment; the gap surfaces as governance pressure. Velocity amplifies and temporally clusters latent weakness. The red loop ends at structural diagnosis — the scarce work.

loops.name: Governance-adaptation loop
loops.type_note: Together with L2 forms a BALANCING loop: adaptation reshapes E to reduce the churn that drove it.
loops.reading: A structural diagnosis triggers an adaptation (model / convert / strengthen / reconcile / retire); the return arm reshapes the environment. Later agents inherit a more compact representation, clearer constraints, fewer invalid moves, earlier evidence, narrower seams, more reliable admission conditions.

loops.name: Capability-amplification loop
loops.type_note: A REINFORCING loop (see R-loop below): self-amplifying, keeps moving the target.
loops.reading: A stronger environment can raise DEPLOYED agentic capacity — feasible task size, more concurrency, more ambitious requirements, cheaper refactoring, denser use of capacity — the frontier the operator dares attempt, NOT the foundation model's intrinsic capability. The expanded frontier exposes new failure classes and reopens the loop. This is why MAGE does not terminate.

loop_typing._note: System-dynamics causal-loop typing (Meadows convention). Naming the types sharpens the non-terminating claim: the balancing loop drives the environment toward fit; the reinforcing loop moves the target the moment it is reached.

B.reading: churn -> diagnosis -> adaptation -> less churn: goal-seeking, self-damping, toward fit.

R.reading: better E -> more ambition -> new frontier: self-amplifying, reopens the loop.

input.reading: seeds E before any failure; not a feedback loop.

moderators.reading: Fit between the work and the DIAGNOSTIC capability a structural reading needs — largely a human/organizational capacity to read a signal as structural, not the fleet's implementation capability (do not read it as the model/task fit of Part 4). Below fit, pressure arrives but no diagnosis converts it — motion without direction.
Ability or organizational path to modify shared architecture and controls. Need not live in one architect; the failure is a path that terminates in a local patch, leaving the class to recur.
Degree to which important obligations can be represented, supplied with evidence and evaluated adequately; mechanical checking is a strong region, not the definition.
Degree to which mechanisms compose without harmful interaction; the guard against a tower of governance.

outcomes.name: Durable throughput
outcomes.measures: Raw implementation converted into lasting system progress.

outcomes.name: Defect escape
outcomes.measures: Relevant failures reaching later lifecycle stages or production.

outcomes.name: Human-attention burden
outcomes.measures: Human judgment required per unit of durable output. State as a RATE, not a ceiling — per-change attention amortizes even while total governance work grows.

apparatus_measures_caveat: Support ratio, control count, gate count and model-sync rate measure investment or accumulation, not outcome. Assess environment properties independently and compare durable throughput, escape and attention; do not define fit solely by favorable outcomes.

propositions.name: Representation leverage
propositions.statement: Trustworthy, task-relevant representations can reduce reconstruction and extend the work that humans and agents can complete at a given quality and resource budget.
scope_conditions: Reconstruction and effective reasoning horizon, not merely context size.
Trustworthy task-relevant distinctions, descriptive/normative correspondence, usefulness and upkeep.
Representations can be designed, recovered or invented; novelty does not confer trust.
Representation innovation can expose previously impractical structure; held-out usefulness and independent validation remain necessary.
propositions.potential_disconfirmation: No gain at matched quality/resources or benefit erased/reversed by stale, misleading or expensive representations.
propositions.core_quantity: Reasoning reach or cost at matched quality, including fidelity and upkeep

legacy_components.name: Discovering new ways to model systems

propositions.name: Representation-enabled enforcement
propositions.statement: An explicit representation can make a selected obligation mechanically decidable, allowing Alignment to enforce it independently of the producing agent’s compliance.
propositions.mechanism: Representation makes an obligation checkable; Alignment enforces it
scope_conditions: Representation can make a selected obligation mechanically decidable.
Alignment gives that obligation consequence independently of producer compliance.
A sound gate excludes its covered failure class; coverage, correspondence and validator correctness remain separate.
Imperfect controls may miss failures or reject good work; compare escape with correct delivery and cost, not escape alone.
propositions.potential_disconfirmation: The representation does not make the relevant property reliably checkable, or assurance gains disappear once false rejection, coverage and cost are matched.
propositions.core_quantity: Escape, false rejection and correct delivery for adequately covered obligations

propositions.name: Governance conversion and engineering capital
propositions.statement: When engineering judgment becomes trustworthy, reusable structure, later work can inherit productive capacity rather than purchase the same reasoning again.
propositions.mechanism: Later work inherits useful engineering judgment
scope_conditions: Earlier judgment becomes inherited productive capacity: reasoning reach, useful abstractions, safer action, evidence, recovery—not only fewer defects.
Lessons propagate to later work and beyond their originator through trustworthy shared structure.
Value depends on reuse or consequence, partial transfer, carrying cost, lost fit, reconciliation and retirement.
Construction/upkeep may become cheaper with agentic capability; that is conditional and does not prove every new asset pays.
propositions.potential_disconfirmation: Later work gains no capability or cost/risk advantage over local repair or on-demand reconstruction once building and carrying the asset are counted.
propositions.core_quantity: Reused capacity and propagation net of construction, carrying cost and lost fit

propositions.name: Governable acceleration
propositions.statement: The effect of additional agentic capacity depends on the environment through which it acts: adequate fit can support durable progress, while poor fit can increase churn, intervention or escaped failure.
propositions.mechanism: Capacity acts through the environment’s fit to the work
scope_conditions: Capacity acts through the environment; it can amplify good fit or inadequacy.
Adequate representations and assurance can turn capacity into durable useful work; weak fit may produce churn, escape or repeated intervention.
Diagnosis and authority permit adaptation; neither follows automatically from faster failures.
Whether models/environment substitute for or complement raw reasoning capability is empirical.
propositions.potential_disconfirmation: Added capacity has essentially the same durable outcome across independently measured environment conditions, or apparent benefits vanish at matched quality and task difficulty.
propositions.core_quantity: Capacity-by-environment effects on durable throughput, escape and human attention

evolution._note: The empirical kernel and the later extensions are epistemically different and must not be blurred.

kernel.source: davis2026cheapcode (Cheap Code, Costly Judgment) — first twelve weeks of the DocAble build
five_step_loop: the engineer classifies the failure as local or structural
structural failures are converted into governance
later agents inherit a narrower, more explicit action space
repeated conversions raise the environment's capacity to absorb future work

extensions: Up-front (bootstrap) governance became a first-class path, complementary to conversion from experience.
Modeling became a coequal route to governability (the Modeling Principle).
Governance accumulation proved non-monotonic — mature adaptation includes reconciliation and retirement.
The process became visibly multi-loop (bootstrap / churn / adaptation / amplification).
